title.zh: 在山区省Bontoc分省Besao市镇设立急诊医院并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of an Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Besao, Subprovince of Bontoc, Mountain Province, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of an Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Besao, Subprovince of Bontoc, Mountain Province, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_4904_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the Bureau of Medical Services, a fifteen-bed capacity hospital in the Municipality of Besao, Subprovince of Bontoc, Mountain Province, to be known as the Besao Emergency Hospital. The site of said hospital shall be provided by the Municipal Council of Besao in consultation with the Director of Medical Services.
The Secretary of Health shall promulgate such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry into effect the purpose of this Act.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment and operation of the said hospital during the fiscal year ending June thirty, nineteen hundred sixty-seven. Such sums as may be necessary for its operations and maintenance in subsequent years shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
